title: app_request_garmin_sync structuredContent
description: Whether a Garmin sync of yesterday and today now was accepted (at most one request every 15 minutes, none while a Garmin job is unfinished), and what is already under way. Listed only while adapters.garmin is on. See contracts/README.md section 2.2.

pendingSince.description: When the unfinished Garmin job was asked for; null when none waits.

nextAllowedAt.description: The earliest time a next request can be accepted (now, when one can be already).
